title: eclipséMC Cobblemon
description: The eclipséMC Cobblemon modpack is our own, customized take on the Cobblemon experience. In addition to various Cobblemon add-ons, the pack includes many quality-of-life (and just plain fun) mods to make the overall gameplay more enjoyable!
body:
![eclipséMC Banner](https://eclipse.paradoxician.com/_assets/media/minecraft/banner.png)
The eclipséMC Cobblemon modpack is our own, customized take on the Cobblemon experience. In addition to various Cobblemon add-ons, the pack includes many quality-of-life (and just plain fun) mods to make the overall gameplay more enjoyable!
